description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认页数从1开始排序。
description.en: The page number from which to start displaying the returned results. Pages start from page 1 by default.

description.zh:
视频设备的设备名称。您可以在[物联网平台控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/devices)的**设备**页面，或调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)接口查看指定产品下设备的**DeviceName**。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the video device. You can view the **DeviceName** of devices under a specified product on the **Devices** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/devices) or by calling the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

description.zh:
视频设备的设备ID。可调用[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)接口查询。

><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the video device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation to query the device ID.

><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device that corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

description.zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。
description.en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console.

description.zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的设备数量，最大值是50。
description.en: The number of devices to display on each page of the returned results. Maximum value: 50.

description.zh:
视频设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。

您可以在[物联网平台控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product)的**产品**页面或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)接口，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the video device belongs.

You can view information about all products under the current instance on the **Products** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product) or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

获取到的录像下载地址有效期为1小时。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

The obtained recording download URL is valid for 1 hour.

## QPS limit

A single Alibaba Cloud account can call this operation up to 50 times per second (QPS).

> All RAM users under a single Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.
